title: source.firewall
description: Tail a firewall log (UFW/iptables kernel BLOCK entries) and emit PortAccess events for the port-scan detector.

adapter.description: Data-source adapter. Currently only 'ufw_file' (tails a UFW/iptables log file) is implemented.

path.description: Path to the firewall log file to tail.

seek_to_end.description: Start at end of file (follow new entries only). Keep true on first run so the existing backlog of BLOCK entries is NOT replayed into the detector.

event_type.description: EventType to label emitted events. Defaults to PortAccess, which is what detector.port_scan consumes.

block_marker.description: Substring a line must contain to be treated as a blocked connection. Use '[UFW BLOCK]' for UFW; set to your iptables LOG prefix otherwise.

protocols.description: Optional protocol allow-list (e.g. ["TCP", "UDP"]). When set, lines whose PROTO is not listed are skipped. Empty/omitted = all protocols.
